description: Comment "Family" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to build your entire family tree and find relatives you didn't even know existed? I tried this and ChatGPT found family members I didn't even know I was related to. Here's how: Prompt 1: "I want to build my full family tree, so ask me everything you need to know: my full name, where my family is from, and every relative I can remember." ChatGPT maps out everything you know into a clean starting tree. Prompt 2: "Now based on my last name and where my family came from, tell me the origins of my family line and how far back you can trace it." ChatGPT pulls the entire history behind your family name. Prompt 3 (the trick): "Using everything you know about me, go search public records, ancestry databases, and obituaries to find relatives connected to my family I don't already have." ChatGPT opens its own browser, digs through every public record it can find, and comes back with relatives you never knew existed. Bonus prompt: "Now build me the full visual family tree with everyone you found and how we're all connected." ChatGPT creates an animation and lays out your entire family tree for you. Comment "Family" and I'll send you all these prompts plus more use cases. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #familytree #ancestry
